chunks: Neither man nor jinn will be questioned on that day about his sin.
ai.seo_question: Who will be questioned about their sins on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Surah Ar-Rahman, this verse highlights the universal scope of divine accountability, specifying that neither humans (ins) nor jinn (jann) will be asked about their sins because their records are already fully known to Allah. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of 'Ilm al-Ghayb' (Knowledge of the Unseen) held by Allah, emphasizing that the questioning is not for His benefit but for the manifestation of justice to the creatures themselves. The phrasing underscores the completeness of the Divine Record, leaving no room for ambiguity or exemption in the final reckoning.
